description: System initialized, key items in storage, waiting for the human to begin
Human opens the kettle lid, signalling intent to make tea (the robot cannot open the lid)
If the bottle is in storage, the robot brings the water bottle to the human
With the lid open, the human pours water into the kettle
After water is poured, the kettle lid is closed and the kettle is switched on; the blue LED turns on
The kettle heats the water until it boils; the blue LED turns off when boiling completes
Robot retrieves the powdered milk container, cup, spoon, tea bag and biscuits from storage to the working area
Human prepares their tea in the cup — adds the tea bag, pours the boiled water, adds powdered milk and stirs
Returns unused items to storage and discards the spent tea bag
